reviews.reason: The external owner/identity changed, so previous draft/error/resource state is explicitly invalidated; the nearest fixture/source demonstrates that lifecycle. SchemaFormDrawer clears submitError when open/resolvedInitialValues changes, after two-step root-store clear then new values to prevent nested merge leaks. The error belongs to the previous submit/record owner and must not remain on the next record; schema-form-drawer tests cover both omitted root/nested values and retained input identity.

Reviewed component responsibilities and existing child boundaries; the flagged declaration length is an investigation signal, not itself a demonstrated defect. SchemaFormDrawer owns Antd form-store initialization, submission status and actions. Its owner-input effect must replace record values while retaining mounted custom controls; schema fields and action/status slots are distinct owners, not a reason to create a reducer or remount the entire drawer.
